reason: A DSH web plugin that provides an interactive animated whale desktop pet reflecting agent states, with customization, local preferences, optional sounds, clipboard copying, and notifications.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH Web 界面提供会随智能体状态变化并支持拖拽、换肤和互动的动画小鲸鱼桌宠。
summaries.en: An animated whale desktop pet for the DSH web interface that reflects agent states and supports dragging, theming, and interactive behaviors.

capabilities: Reads DSH agent session status to drive animations
Renders an interactive DOM-based desktop pet widget
Stores user preferences and widget positions locally
Can copy displayed error text to the clipboard
Can optionally request system notification permission
